name: Grissom ARB
description: Stand-alone Air Force Reserve base hosting 434th ARW KC-135R operations. Joint-use with Grissom Aeroplex.

currentNotifications.title: REAL ID Required for Base Access
currentNotifications.body: A REAL ID-compliant driver's license or equivalent is required for base access per DHS mandate. All visitors must obtain a base pass through the Visitor Center.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: Bring PCS or assignment orders, CAC, medical and dental records, and marriage or birth certificates if applicable. Carry finance and travel receipts for settlement. Reserve personnel should confirm UTA reporting instructions with their gaining unit.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your Unit Command Support Staff (CSS) normal business hours (Mon-Fri 0730-1630) or as directed for UTA. Attend the newcomers briefing at the Military & Family Readiness Center. Visit Finance and MPF in the Bldg 606 area for pay and ID card actions.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: No on-base family housing at Grissom ARB — all housing is off-base in Peru, Kokomo, and surrounding communities. Contact the M&FRC for relocation assistance. Grissom Inn offers temporary lodging (no pets/smoking) — book early during UTA weekends.

sections.title: Gate Access & Reserve Base Services
sections.body: Main Gate on Hoosier Blvd is open 24/7. Visitor Center: 765-688-4352. This is a stand-alone reserve base with limited daily services — no commissary, no on-base medical clinic, and a small BX Troop Store only. Nearest commissary is at Fort Harrison, Indianapolis. Plan medical care through TRICARE network providers.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: Official installation resources plus Military OneSource for reserve relocation support. Joint-use airfield operations with Grissom Aeroplex.
